types.name: HoverHighlightProps
types.doc: A group in which one shared background pill glides to the item under the pointer or holding keyboard focus. Use it for nav rows, menus and toolbars. With a `value`, the pill rests on that item and returns to it when the pointer leaves.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: Direction the items flow in. It also decides which arrow keys move focus.

members.name: tone
members.doc: Pill color: a quiet neutral wash, or the solid accent with dark text on top.

members.name: value
members.doc: Value of the item the pill rests on while nothing is hovered (controlled). Pass null for none.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called when someone picks an item that has a `value`.

members.name: arrowNavigation
members.doc: Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between items.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the group element.

members.name: children
members.doc: `HoverHighlightItem`s, or any elements carrying `data-highlight-item`, at any depth.

members.name: value
members.doc: Identifies the item for `value` and `onValueChange`. Items without a value only take the hover pill.

members.name: href
members.doc: Renders a link instead of a button.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Leaves the item out of hover, focus and selection.
